tips.text: Spend no Cryotic on dojo research, the Helminth or other Cryotic builds until the Sibear is built.
Farm Alloy Plate and build the Magistar first, then run Excavation fissures whenever you want relics and let the Cryotic build up.
Most owners got there through years of incidental Excavation; a one-sitting grind for the 30,000 burns people out.
